ground_truth_provenance.details: Official train annotation JSON is passed to the evaluator; model output is not ground truth.

score_normalization.details: No normalization by the model's own prediction statistics was found.

result_existence.details: Five completed jobs have matching receipts, checkpoints, metrics, and source identities.

metric_operationalization.details: The manifest lists lifecycle, identity, calibration, and systems metrics that the pilot finalizer does not require.

scope.details: One seed and train-prefix diagnostics cannot establish generalization or paper-level superiority.

threshold_integrity.details: Native thresholds stayed fixed; D1 birth/end used argmax with no numeric logit threshold; no search or lowering occurred.

scientific_gate.details: Qualitative criteria exist, but quantitative effect-size, coverage, confidence, and sample-size cutoffs were not preregistered.
